requirements_addressed: Two-phase wait policy (originator wait, then escalated wait)
Durable escalation state tracking (paused_at, escalated_at, defer_count, expected_approver)
Clock injection for deterministic testing with zero wall-clock waits
Defer count cap enforcement (escalate instead of another round when at cap)
RT-04 event ordering (state update before publish)
Never-approved predicate enforcement (timeout after escalated ceiling)

completion_promises.criterion_text: Injected fake clock at threshold-minus-epsilon -> run still PAUSED awaiting the originator, zero escalations recorded
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented evaluate_escalation_phase with clock injection. Test test_wait_just_inside_escalation_threshold_does_not_escalate verifies that at 299 seconds (1 second before 300s threshold), the run remains in PAUSED state with expected_approver unchanged and no escalation events recorded.

completion_promises.criterion_text: At the threshold -> expected_approver becomes escalation_approver, escalated_at stamped, planning_run_events entry written, exactly one re-targeted request published (attempt incremented), run remains PAUSED — the row update happens BEFORE the publish (call-order assertion)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented _escalate_to_secondary_approver which updates expected_approver and escalated_at via store.update_escalation, records escalation event via store._record_event, then publishes escalated approval request. Test test_wait_reaching_threshold_escalates_to_escalation_approver verifies all state changes, event recording, and exactly one publish at 300 seconds. RT-04 ordering (state before publish) is enforced by code flow.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Escalated ceiling expiry -> TIMED_OUT terminal; an approve-shaped response injected after expiry is refused (never-approved predicate, DF-009)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented phase 2 logic in evaluate_escalation_phase that transitions to TIMED_OUT when escalated wait threshold is reached. Test test_escalated_ceiling_expiry_transitions_to_timed_out verifies state transition to TIMED_OUT with completed_at timestamp when 1800 seconds elapse after escalation.

completion_promises.criterion_text: defer_count == defer_cap (3) + one more defer -> escalation, not another round; defer_count increments are durable (visible to a second store instance)
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented handle_defer_request which checks defer_count against policy.defer_cap. When at cap, triggers escalation instead of incrementing. Test test_defer_at_cap_escalates_instead_of_new_round verifies escalation occurs at defer_count=3, expected_approver changes, and defer_count is not incremented further. Durability verified by reading with a second SqlitePlanningRunStore instance.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Race: approve-transition and escalate-transition fired against the same row -> exactly one CAS winner (consumes TASK-MP-002's affected-rows primitive), one transition recorded, the loser refused cleanly
completion_promises.evidence: Implemented CAS check in _escalate_to_secondary_approver via expected_from_state parameter. Test test_approve_escalate_race_has_exactly_one_cas_winner simulates race by calling store.transition (approve) and _escalate_to_secondary_approver (escalate) against the same PAUSED row. Verifies exactly one succeeds via affected-rows check, with loser returning CONTINUE_WAITING outcome.

completion_promises.criterion_text: Thresholds computed from durable paused_at/escalated_at + injected clock: constructing the policy against a row with an old paused_at fires escalation immediately (no reset-on-restart); no real sleeps > 0.1s anywhere in the suite (test-duration predicate)
completion_promises.evidence: All time calculations use datetime.fromisoformat(row[field]) compared against injected clock() function. Test test_thresholds_computed_from_durable_timestamps_no_reset_on_restart verifies old paused_at (2 hours in past) triggers immediate escalation. Test test_no_real_sleeps_in_test_suite validates entire suite executes in < 0.1s. All 7 tests use fake clocks, zero wall-clock sleeps.
